Per-skill server cooldown authority has not been source-backed for the complete catalog; client recast values remain metadata only.

Player-vs-player target legality, rewards and death-loss policy are intentionally fail-closed until injected.
Skill-tree/UI binding and exact binary animation/self-FX/target-FX/icon mappings must be completed before claiming real-client usable skills.
Two-player/mob HP-MP-cooldown and kill->XP->relog persistence need one final real C++/WASM + Docker/PostgreSQL composed acceptance run.
